audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] and spikes[0].text say Frenzied Maul "shreds armor" — Riot's text says it applies on-hit effects, marks the target, and the second cast on a marked target deals bonus damage and heals him. No armour shred anywhere. Three do/don't bodies were generic boilerplate that did not match their titles, and nothing recorded that Thundering Smash is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags all three: needs-antiheal (Frenzied Maul, a 5s cooldown), autoreset-burst-tell (Thundering Smash), and onhit-itemization (his damage rides attack speed via the passive, so armour alone misreads the trade).
audit.corrected: The armour-shred claim replaced with the real second-bite heal; dosFull[1].d gives the reset tell and the 12s stun, dosFull[2].d gives the 5s Frenzied Maul cooldown and Executioner's Calling, dontsFull[1].d explains the long trade.
